admission.justification: Unit tests verify verbatim-vs-stub routing across all ten kinds, verbatim where and equation-arm | formatting without :=, exact line alignment and byte-identical re-rendering, preventing broken declaration links or malformed verbatim stubs.

applicability: Deterministic Lean 4 skeleton file rendering and DagDeclarationRef line-range alignment in src/rh_pipeline/lean/stub_emitter.py.
conditions: Emits structure, inductive, class, opaque and axiom always verbatim, def and abbrev verbatim iff preserve_defs=True, and theorem, lemma, instance and non-preserved def/abbrev bodies as sorry EXTRACTED_STUB lines.

_format_verbatim_declaration omits := for where bodies and line-initial equation-compiler | arms while retaining := for norm (|x|) and ordinary bodies; returned DagDeclarationRef spans match rendered 1-based lines exactly, with end_line excluding the trailing EXTRACTED_DEF comment on verbatim blocks and including the sorry line on stub blocks.
exclusions: Omits module and import lines from emitted skeleton files; imports remain on ExtractedModule for DAG construction.

Emitted stub signatures reproduce the signatures extracted by parser.py and are not guaranteed syntactically self-contained when a return type contains a depth-0 let ... := binding (20 stubs across 10 skeleton files, tracked as an open weakness on parser.py::_scan_body_delim).
statement: render_skeleton_file emits deterministic provenance-annotated Lean skeleton files with provenance headers, preserving structure/inductive/class/opaque/axiom and (when preserve_defs=True) def/abbrev bodies with EXTRACTED_DEF comments—omitting := for verbatim where and equation-compiler | arm bodies—while replacing theorem/lemma/instance (and non-preserved def/abbrev) bodies with EXTRACTED_STUB sorry lines and returning exact DagDeclarationRef line ranges.
title: Deterministic provenance-preserving Lean stub emission
